name: Kletterhütte Ilmenau

coord_source.ref: Nominatim house point for Bahnhofstraße 18, 98693 Ilmenau (a residential building in Oberpörlitz); the gym page itself says "Exact location coming soon"

research_notes: Own site (read 2026-10-06): "Opening soon", "Coming to Ilmenau", newsletter sign-up only, "Modern bouldering walls with regularly updated routes", contact says "Exact location coming soon". No opening date, hours or prices. The address Bahnhofstr. 18 appears only in the legal notice and may be the operator's address. Not open: blocked. The Ilmblocks project (ilmblocks.de, crowdfunding) is also still only planned, and the Fischerhütte climbing-hall idea (inSüdthüringen, 20 May 2026) is at planning stage; neither is a candidate.

name: Kletter- & Freizeithalle Schmölln
research_notes: Municipal page: hall at Coßwitzanger 30, public climbing Mon 16-18 (children and youth up to 18) and Wed 17-20 (experienced adults and families), "mehrere bunte Kletterwände und eine kleine Boulderhöhle", closed on public holidays and in frost. The operator (theBASE / Magdalenenstift, volunteer group) confirms the hall and the same public slots and offers DAV climbing courses, but never mentions bouldering; its home page says "ACHTUNG: Ab April kommt die Kletterhalle aus der WINTERPAUSE", so the hall may be closed in winter and the notice may be stale. The Stift page places the hall at "Poststraße / Ecke Coswitzanger"; OSM has the building as Coßwitzanger 1 (the city page says 30). status_claim is unknown because the winter closure could not be settled.

name: Life Kletterhalle Saalfeld

coord_source.ref: way 198319533 (building, leisure=fitness_centre "Life Fitness Club", website life-saalfeld.de; tagged addr Albert-Schweitzer-Straße 51 while the club site says Stauffenbergstraße 51)

research_notes: Own pages (2026-10-06): hours Mon-Fri 8-22, Sat-Sun 10-19; "Unsere Kletterhalle ist durchgehend zu unseren Öffnungszeiten ohne Betreuung nutzbar"; 2026 course dates (Toprope 17.09-08.10.2026) and autumn-holiday climbing 13-20 Oct 2026; a consent form "Selbstständiges Bouldern". The club's own Benutzungsordnung says rope-free climbing is allowed only "im Boulderraum" (soft-floor mats) and the AGB list a "Boulderbereich inklusive Trainingsbereich" and forbid bouldering in the lead areas. Wall builder page: bouldering hall 165 m2 (2010), rope hall 460 m2, 12 m. Price not on the own pages (a tourism directory says 15 EUR with harness). Address mismatch: the club site says Stauffenbergstraße 51, OSM tags the same house number on Albert-Schweitzer-Straße; the OSM building carries the club's website, so it is the gym.

name: St. Veit Climbing Tower (DAV Meiningen)

coord_source.ref: way 591242653 (St. Veit church building, addr Rainstraße 23, Sülzfeld; the wall is in its bell tower)

research_notes: Own site: climbing centre of the DAV section Meiningen in the bell tower of St. Veit church since 1 Jan 2015, 125 m2, "Wandhöhe 6 m, Routen ca. 26, Boulderbereich 2,5 m". Address Rainstraße 23, 98617 Sülzfeld (Anfahrt page). Public use: supervised "Freies Klettern mit Betreuung für Erwachsene" Tue and Thu 19:30-21:30; the price list includes non-members (adults 7 EUR for 2 h, youth 6 EUR); independent climbing needs a climbing licence and a key by arrangement, none on Sundays and holidays or during church events. Not a bouldering-first gym: the boulder area is small beside the rope walls. The first pass (dee-012) deferred it for no boulder area and no address; both are now on the own pages. The other OSM climbing node "Kletterwand Kirchenburg" (50.6126, 10.3884) is a different place and was not used.

name: Kletterzentrum Zuckerturm
research_notes: Own site (2026-10-06): run by the DAV section Bergfreunde Anhalt Dessau, 20-year jubilee on 3 Oct 2026, day prices (adult 15 EUR, for people who can toprope; beginners must book an introduction course). Hours page: "Feste Öffnungszeiten haben wir aktuell leider nicht"; open at least during course times, other use by e-mail or hotline arrangement, members with a key 8-22. Hall facts: 660 m2 climbing area, 24 toprope and 26 lead lines, about 70 routes; no boulder area is listed. The only boulder mentions are the DAV "Boulderregeln" text and a mobile boulder block for events. A directory search summary claims a bouldering area, which the own pages do not support. Bouldering offer therefore unknown, not confirmed absent.

name: DAV Kletterhalle Ensdorf

coord_source.ref: way 98872570 (building, "DAV Kletterhalle Ensdorf", sport=climbing; operator tag outdated)

research_notes: DAV Sektion Saarbrücken (ASS) hall page (read 2026-10-06): 200 m2 climbing area, 80 m2 Boulderfläche, 7.5 m walls; training times Mon 16:30-18 youth and 18:30-20:30 adults, Wed 18-20 adults, Fri 16-18 youth and 18:30-20:30 adults ("Klettertreff für Erwachsene / selbstständige Kletterer"); use needs a form and a fee, the form is available through the office. The page is undated and shows the same schedule as the 27 Feb 2022 announcement, but the section blog shows the hall in current use: "Tag der offenen Tür 2026" on 7 Nov 2026 10-17 (post of 14 Sep 2026), new routes in April 2025, youth assembly at the hall in Dec 2025. The OSM operator tag still names the old section Bergfreunde Saar.
